'true' is the preferred configuration in development mode, while 'false' or 'null' might be preferred in production

children.name: metadata_update_threshold
children.info: Seconds to wait between 2 session metadata updates.

children.name: excluded_patterns
children.info: Array of glob patterns of asset file paths that should not be in the asset mapper.

children.name: exclude_dotfiles
children.info: If true, any files starting with "." will be excluded from the asset mapper.

children.name: server
children.info: If true, a "dev server" will return the assets from the public directory (true in "debug" mode only by default).

children.name: public_prefix
children.info: The public path where the assets will be written to (and served from when "server" is true).

children.name: vendor_dir
children.info: The directory to store JavaScript vendors.

children.name: precompress
children.info: Precompress assets with Brotli, Zstandard and gzip.

children.name: extensions
children.info: Array of extensions to compress. The entire list must be provided, no merging occurs.

children.info: Max time in ms that a retry should ever be delayed (0 = infinite).

children.name: rate_limiter
children.info: Rate limiter name to use when processing messages.

children.info: Max time in ms that a retry should ever be delayed (0 = infinite).

children.name: jitter
children.info: Randomness in percent (between 0 and 1) to apply to the delay.

children.name: mock_response_factory
children.info: `true` to always return empty 200 responses, or the id of the service to use to generate mock responses - which should be either an invokable or an iterable.

children.name: scope
children.info: The regular expression that the request URL must match before adding the other options. When none is provided, the base URI is used instead.

children.name: base_uri
children.info: The URI to resolve relative URLs, following rules in RFC 3985, section 2.

children.name: auth_basic
children.info: An HTTP Basic authentication "username:password".

children.name: auth_bearer
children.info: A token enabling HTTP Bearer authorization.

children.name: auth_ntlm
children.info: A "username:password" pair to use Microsoft NTLM authentication (requires the cURL extension).

children.name: query
children.info: Associative array of query string values merged with the base URI.

children.name: headers
children.info: Associative array: header => value(s).

children.name: max_redirects
children.info: The maximum number of redirects to follow.

children.name: http_version
children.info: The default HTTP version, typically 1.1 or 2.0, leave to null for the best version.

children.name: resolve
children.info: Associative array: domain => IP.

children.name: proxy
children.info: The URL of the proxy to pass requests through or null for automatic detection.

children.name: no_proxy
children.info: A comma separated list of hosts that do not require a proxy to be reached.

children.name: timeout
children.info: The idle timeout, defaults to the "default_socket_timeout" ini parameter.

children.name: max_duration
children.info: The maximum execution time for the request+response as a whole.

children.name: bindto
children.info: A network interface name, IP address, a host name or a UNIX socket to bind to.

children.name: verify_peer
children.info: Indicates if the peer should be verified in a TLS context.

children.name: verify_host
children.info: Indicates if the host should exist as a certificate common name.

children.name: cafile
children.info: A certificate authority file.

children.name: capath
children.info: A directory that contains multiple certificate authority files.

children.name: local_cert
children.info: A PEM formatted certificate file.

children.name: local_pk
children.info: A private key file.

children.name: passphrase
children.info: The passphrase used to encrypt the "local_pk" file.

children.name: ciphers
children.info: A list of TLS ciphers separated by colons, commas or spaces (e.g. "RC3-SHA:TLS13-AES-128-GCM-SHA256"...).

children.name: peer_fingerprint
children.info: Associative array: hashing algorithm => hash(es).

children.name: crypto_method
children.info: The minimum version of TLS to accept; must be one of STREAM_CRYPTO_METHOD_TLSv*_CLIENT constants.

children.name: mock_response_factory
children.info: `true` to always return empty 200 responses, `false` to disable mocking, or the id of the service to use to generate mock responses (invokable or iterable).

children.name: extra
children.info: Extra options for specific HTTP client.

children.name: rate_limiter
children.info: Rate limiter name to use for throttling requests.

children.name: caching
children.info: Caching configuration.

children.name: cache_pool
children.info: The taggable cache pool to use for storing the responses.

children.name: shared
children.info: Indicates whether the cache is shared (public) or private.

children.name: max_ttl
children.info: The maximum TTL (in seconds) allowed for cached responses.

children.name: retry_strategy
children.info: service id to override the retry strategy.

children.name: http_codes
children.info: A list of HTTP status code that triggers a retry.

children.name: methods
children.info: A list of HTTP methods that triggers a retry for this status code. When empty, all methods are retried.

children.name: delay
children.info: Time in ms to delay (or the initial value when multiplier is used).

children.name: multiplier
children.info: If greater than 1, delay will grow exponentially for each retry: delay * (multiple ^ retries).

children.name: max_delay
children.info: Max time in ms that a retry should ever be delayed (0 = infinite).

children.name: jitter
children.info: Randomness in percent (between 0 and 1) to apply to the delay.

children.name: mailer
children.info: Mailer configuration

children.name: message_bus
children.info: The message bus to use. Defaults to the default bus if the Messenger component is installed.

children.name: envelope
children.info: Mailer Envelope configuration

children.name: allowed_recipients
children.info: A list of regular expressions that allow recipients when "recipients" option is defined.

children.name: dkim_signer
children.info: DKIM signer configuration

children.name: key
children.info: Key content, or path to key (in PEM format with the `file://` prefix)

children.name: passphrase
children.info: The private key passphrase

children.name: smime_signer
children.info: S/MIME signer configuration

children.name: key
children.info: Path to key (in PEM format)

children.name: certificate
children.info: Path to certificate (in PEM format without the `file://` prefix)

children.name: passphrase
children.info: The private key passphrase

children.name: smime_encrypter
children.info: S/MIME encrypter configuration

children.name: repository
children.info: S/MIME certificate repository service. This service shall implement the `Symfony\Component\Mailer\EventListener\SmimeCertificateRepositoryInterface`.

children.name: cipher
children.info: A set of algorithms used to encrypt the message

children.name: notifier
children.info: Notifier configuration

children.name: message_bus
children.info: The message bus to use. Defaults to the default bus if the Messenger component is installed.

children.name: rate_limiter
children.info: Rate limiter configuration

children.name: lock_factory
children.info: The service ID of the lock factory used by this limiter (or null to disable locking).

children.name: cache_pool
children.info: The cache pool to use for storing the current limiter state.

children.name: storage_service
children.info: The service ID of a custom storage implementation, this precedes any configured "cache_pool".

children.name: policy
children.info: The algorithm to be used by this limiter.

children.name: limiters
children.info: The limiter names to use when using the "compound" policy.

children.name: limit
children.info: The maximum allowed hits in a fixed interval or burst.

children.name: interval
children.info: Configures the fixed interval if "policy" is set to "fixed_window" or "sliding_window". The value must be a number followed by "second", "minute", "hour", "day", "week" or "month" (or their plural equivalent).

children.name: rate
children.info: Configures the fill rate if "policy" is set to "token_bucket".

children.name: interval
children.info: Configures the rate interval. The value must be a number followed by "second", "minute", "hour", "day", "week" or "month" (or their plural equivalent).

children.name: amount
children.info: Amount of tokens to add each interval.

children.name: anchor_at
children.info: Aligns the "fixed_window" policy to a calendar (e.g. "2024-01-05 00:00:00 UTC" combined with `interval: 1 month` resets the counter on the 5th of each month). UTC if not specified.

children.name: uid
children.info: Uid configuration

children.name: uuid47_secret
children.info: A high-entropy secret used by the "uuid47_transformer" service. Defaults to "kernel.secret".

children.name: html_sanitizer
children.info: HtmlSanitizer configuration

children.name: default_action
children.info: Defines how the sanitizer must behave by default.

children.name: allow_safe_elements
children.info: Allows "safe" elements and attributes.

children.name: allow_static_elements
children.info: Allows all static elements and attributes from the W3C Sanitizer API standard.

children.name: allow_elements
children.info: Configures the elements that the sanitizer should retain from the input. The element name is the key, the value is either a list of allowed attributes for this element or "*" to allow the default set of attributes (https://wicg.github.io/sanitizer-api/#default-configuration).

children.name: block_elements
children.info: Configures elements as blocked. Blocked elements are elements the sanitizer should remove from the input, but retain their children.

children.name: drop_elements
children.info: Configures elements as dropped. Dropped elements are elements the sanitizer should remove from the input, including their children.

children.name: allow_attributes
children.info: Configures attributes as allowed. Allowed attributes are attributes the sanitizer should retain from the input.

children.name: drop_attributes
children.info: Configures attributes as dropped. Dropped attributes are attributes the sanitizer should remove from the input.

children.name: force_attributes
children.info: Forcefully set the values of certain attributes on certain elements.

children.name: force_https_urls
children.info: Transforms URLs using the HTTP scheme to use the HTTPS scheme instead.

children.name: allowed_link_schemes
children.info: Allows only a given list of schemes to be used in links href attributes.

children.name: allowed_link_hosts
children.info: Allows only a given list of hosts to be used in links href attributes.

children.name: allow_relative_links
children.info: Allows relative URLs to be used in links href attributes.

children.name: allowed_media_schemes
children.info: Allows only a given list of schemes to be used in media source attributes (img, audio, video, ...).

children.name: allowed_media_hosts
children.info: Allows only a given list of hosts to be used in media source attributes (img, audio, video, ...).

children.name: allow_relative_medias
children.info: Allows relative URLs to be used in media source attributes (img, audio, video, ...).

children.name: with_attribute_sanitizers
children.info: Registers custom attribute sanitizers.

children.name: without_attribute_sanitizers
children.info: Unregisters custom attribute sanitizers.

children.name: max_input_length
children.info: The maximum length allowed for the sanitized input.

children.name: webhook
children.info: Webhook configuration

children.name: message_bus
children.info: The message bus to use.

children.name: secret
children.info: The secret used to verify incoming request signatures. It must be set in production: with an empty value, depending on the parser, requests from any sender are accepted or every request is rejected.

children.name: remote_event
children.info: RemoteEvent configuration

children.name: json_streamer
children.info: JSON streamer configuration

children.name: include_null_properties
children.info: Encode the properties with null value

children.name: default_path
children.info: The default path used to load templates.

children.name: file_name_pattern
children.info: Pattern of file name used for cache warmer and linter.

children.name: date
children.info: The default format options used by the date filter.

children.name: timezone
children.info: The timezone used when formatting dates, when set to null, the timezone returned by date_default_timezone_get() is used.

children.name: number_format
children.info: The default format options for the number_format filter.

children.name: html_to_text_converter
children.info: A service implementing the "Symfony\Component\Mime\HtmlToTextConverter\HtmlToTextConverterInterface".
